bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual evaluation of synthetic résumés by injecting demographic signals (e.g., languages, volunteering, hobbies) representing different ethnicities (White, Black, Hispanic, Asian) and measuring systematic score disparities and bias amplification in multi-agent hiring decisions.

Counterfactual evaluation of synthetic résumés by injecting demographic signals representing male and female candidates and measuring systematic score disparities and bias amplification in multi-agent hiring decisions.
